name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for RPF/RPSF (Ministry of Railways)
provider: Ministry of Railways (Railway Board, Security Directorate) under the National Defence Fund

value: RPF/RPSF personnel (ex/serving, below gazetted rank); widows
rules.quote: Category (III): Wards of ex-RPF/RPSF (retired) personnel. Category (IV): Wards of serving RPF/RPSF personnel.
Students should have secured 60% and above in Minimum Entry Qualification (MEQ) i.e. 12 th Std., Diploma/Graduation.

value: professional degree courses (BE/B.Tech, MBBS, BDS, B.Ed, BBA, BCA, B.Pharma, MBA, MCA, 5-yr integrated law)
rules.quote: Professional Degree Courses like BE, B.Tech, BDS, MBBS, BEd, BBS, BCA, MCA B. Pharma, etc. duly recognized by the respective Government Regulatory Bodies
Master Degree Courses are not eligible for PMSS except MBA, MCA

rules.value: only two wards per family; one course only
rules.quote: The scholarship is admissible for only two wards per family

rules.value: 150 scholarships per session, 75 reserved for girls
rules.quote: A total number of 150 students (from academic session 2015-16) have been earmarked to RPF for an academic session. Half of the scholarships are reserved for female candidates i.e. 75.
Only the institutes/universities/colleges having AISHE regulation will be permissible.

amount.text: Rs 2,500 per month for male students; Rs 3,000 per month for female students; 2 to 5 years
amount.quote: (i) 2500/- per month for male students (ii) 3000/- per month for female students

documents.name: Service certificate (serving personnel) or PPO/discharge certificate (ex-personnel)
documents.quote: A copy of PPO/Discharge certificate/book for Categories I, II and III.

documents.name: MEQ marksheet / grade card
documents.quote: Applicants are required to upload scanned copy of the mark-sheet/Grade card of MEQ i.e. 10+2/ Diploma/Graduation (as the case may be).

deadline.text: Guideline schedule: online application by 31 October; NSP 2026-27 lists student application close 31-10-2026
deadline.quote: Filling of online application by the applicant on www.scholarship.gov.in 31 October
